finding: Amplify job 112 deployed successfully, but the first full production pathway verification timed out opening the mobile navigation. Four desktop pathway groups and all thirteen homepage groups passed; that partial report remains preserved.
controlled_diagnosis: A fresh mobile browser accepted a menu click while the server-rendered button had no React props/listeners attached. Its aria-expanded stayed false and no dialog appeared after the client attached. Diagnostic React DOM properties are an implementation-specific observation, not a proposed product readiness API. The first diagnostic used an inaccessible role locator after opening a modal and timed out; the second preserves before/after DOM snapshots using an ordinary element selector.
correction: Keep the mobile Sheet trigger disabled in server output and initial hydration. React useSyncExternalStore exposes true only on the client; enabling the control then preserves its existing controlled open state and event handlers. This changes no experiment, measurement, source, prompt or database record.
added_release_blocker: Hold back the actual Next.js client script requests in a fresh 390-pixel browser. Require the visible server-rendered menu trigger to be disabled. Release the script gate, click once through normal Playwright enabled/actionability waiting, and require the correct module navigation to appear without retries or arbitrary sleeps. The gate must have withheld at least one script.
verification: Run the added controlled check and existing pathway checks against the built local server and the final production release. Repeat frontend tests, lint and build; reuse unchanged backend/database evidence. Retain job 112 and its original partial verification rather than rewriting it as a passing release.
independence: Development regression created after observing the failure; not held-out validation.
conditional_gaps: Real Google owner/cross-owner and authenticated chat requests still require a legitimate available session.
